records.title: Sorting the Numbers
records.treatment: Two simultaneous classification criteria and explicit row/column meanings.
records.adopted: Place a record according to both named attributes, explain the intersection and allow alternative clear arrangements.
records.rejected: Number-property classification is broader than this lesson; it is not an added prerequisite. No source diagrams copied.
records.usageRestrictions: Reference and original adaptation only; no task text, pupil quotations or images reproduced; no licence transfer inferred.
records.limitations: Age7–11 comparable teaching problem, not Finnish curriculum authority or efficacy evidence for this page.

records.title: Improving Mathematics in Key Stages Two and Three — Guidance Report
records.organization: Education Endowment Foundation, original guidance hosted by U.S. Department of Education ERIC
records.treatment: Representations need a defined mathematical purpose and links to the underlying structure; feedback should identify a useful repair.
records.adopted: One observation mapped to one labelled intersection before independently filling the provided practice grid; feedback identifies both attributes.
records.rejected: A decorative table animation or recognition of a prepared correct table is not the whole process objective. No generic efficacy or strength-of-evidence claim.
records.usageRestrictions: Original EEF report retrieved in full via ERIC after landing-page cache miss. No protected prose or figures copied.
records.limitations: Research-informed guidance, not a new trial of this system. The general representation evidence is not uniformly strong; no project learning effect is inferred.

inventory.intro: A long observation list becomes readable in a table.
inventory.demo: twoWayScene maps day+animal chips into labelled crossing cells.
inventory.generators: Prepared-table recognition; one-cell count; header layout choice; four-value token placement; two-way table transfer.
inventory.hint: Match both day and animal; count only the requested pair.
inventory.feedback: Distinguishes swapped days, swapped animals, wrong total and miscounted cell.
inventory.media: twoWayScene with per-record accumulation and row/column highlight.
inventory.audit: Reports two-way sorting, fill game and feedback/hints corrected; source history is not acceptance evidence.

alignment.inherited: Two-attribute observation records, explicit headings and one-record/one-cell accumulation.
alignment.extended: Construct all cell counts, preserve them under transposition, allow equal counts in different cells and distinguish zero from missing input.
alignment.corrected: Do not require all cell values to be distinct or treat a number token as single-use. A recognized prepared table is not independently authored table structure. Complete synthetic data are explicitly distinguished from unobserved groups.

planning.assumed: Given complete observation list; two known labels per record, small-count reading/recording0–8 assumed or supported. Names are supplied; identifying real species or geometric shapes is not required.
planning.scope: Organize supplied categorical observations in a supplied2×2 grid, including transposition; not an independent field study or arbitrary table design.
planning.evidenceLimits: Prompted low-stakes construction and checking. Model and source list are visible assistance, not independent mastery; no personal history, retention or empirical-population inference.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Frozen3–6 process role, representation node kind, direct-curriculum source basis and required AND group preserved. Foreign guidance supports design, not a new OPH claim; story/data/scenarios are project-authored fiction.
planning.assetProvenance: Original SVG and deterministic table renderer; supplied unchanged Loikka map PNG. Public licensing holds remain.

extensions.dataProvenance: Explicitly fictional complete lists, not real learners or collected personal information.
